🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: "There's always some noise and controversy around me, especially when I'm away. For one reason or another, this always happens in the summer when there are no matches or when I'm injured." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: "I see myself in midfield, but if the coach asks me to play as a center-back, or in any other position, I'll always do it for the team." #fcblive
